notes: that which they had spun is treated as the noun מַטְוֶה recast as a headless relative clause under rule 46, so nothing in it is added.
חַכְמַת is an articleless attributive recast as a relative clause and keeps that were wise with itself (rule 41).
The scarlet chain fuses under rule 30 while its article takes the single written the under rule 29.
